markets.rules_primary: If the national House popular vote margin (D − R) minus the VoteHub 2026 generic ballot margin (D − R, time-weighted) at 10:00 AM ET on November 3, 2026 is below -6.9 in the 2026 U.S. House general election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The national House popular vote margin is the vote percentage received by all Democratic party House candidates minus the vote percentage received by all Republican party House candidates in the general election, as reported by the Clerk of the House, with each percentage taken over all votes cast; the margin is calculated from unrounded percentages and then rounded to one decimal place. The reference margin is the VoteHub 2026 generic congressional ballot margin (Democratic minus Republican, time-weighted) as displayed to one decimal place at 10:00 AM ET on November 3, 2026. The value is the national House popular vote margin minus the reference margin: positive if Democrats outperform the reference margin and negative if Republicans do. Each range includes both of its endpoints.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the median first-year associate base salary for the largest law-firm-size category in the 2027 U.S. Associate Salary Survey is above $215,000, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the national median first-year associate base salary reported for the largest law-firm-size category in NALP’s 2027 U.S. Associate Salary Survey. “Largest law-firm-size category” means the category in NALP’s national firm-size breakdown with the highest minimum number of lawyers. For example, the largest category in the 2025 survey was firms with more than 700 lawyers. If NALP changes its firm-size categories in the 2027 survey, the largest category reported by NALP will be used.

Resolution will use base salary only. Bonuses, benefits, summer-associate compensation, clerkship bonuses, total compensation, and inflation adjustments will not be considered. The median reported by NALP will be used without independent recalculation or rounding.

Resolution will use the first official NALP publication that reports the applicable 2027 median. Later revisions or corrections will not affect resolution.

markets.rules_primary: If NPP wins the 2027 Gambian parliamentary election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
NPP: the National People's Party. UDP: the United Democratic Party. UNITE: the United Movement for Change (UMC).

A party's seats are the elected constituency seats the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) declares won by candidates standing under that party's name. Seats the President appoints are not counted, nor are seats won by independents. A candidate who is only backed by a party but is listed by the IEC under another party or as an independent does not count for it. Allied parties are counted separately, never as a bloc. If a party merges into another registered party before the election, its seats count for the successor party.

For parliamentary/legislative elections, the winner is the party, coalition, or alliance winning the most seats in the specified chamber. If two parties have the same number of seats, the one with the higher share of the vote will resolve to Yes and all others to No. Share of the vote means the total valid votes cast for a party's candidates in the constituency elections, as published by the IEC.

This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If ﻿﻿﻿legislation imposing binding statewide obligations on data centers or a large-load subset of them (or on utility cost allocation for such load) governing energy use or procurement, water use, or ratepayer protection is enacted in Illinois before May 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the first roll-call vote for Speaker occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Hakeem Jeffries is elected Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives on the first ballot of the Speaker election at the opening of the 120th Congress before Feb 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The first ballot is the first roll-call vote for Speaker at the opening of the 120th Congress. The count is 1 if Hakeem Jeffries is declared elected Speaker on it, which requires a majority of the votes cast for a person by name, and 0 otherwise, including if no roll-call vote for Speaker is held before Feb 1, 2027.

The following do NOT count:
A later ballot on which Hakeem Jeffries is elected
A first ballot on which no candidate receives a majority, even if Hakeem Jeffries receives the most votes

The result is determined from the roll call record of the Clerk of the U.S. House of Representatives.
markets.title: Will Hakeem Jeffries be elected Speaker on the first ballot at the opening of the 120th Congress?

The first ballot is the first roll-call vote for Speaker at the opening of the 120th Congress. The count is the number of votes cast for Hakeem Jeffries on it, and 0 if no roll-call vote for Speaker is held before Feb 1, 2027.

The following do NOT count:
Votes cast for Hakeem Jeffries on a later ballot
Votes recorded as Present or Not Voting, or cast for any other candidate

The result is determined from the roll call record of the Clerk of the U.S. House of Representatives.
